primary_metrics.correctness: exact oracle digest equality; any mismatch invalidates affected confirmation claim
primary_metrics.memory: sampled owned-process-group peak RSS, reported separately from cgroup limits
primary_metrics.refusals: all typed refusals retained; no confirmation case may be dropped after execution begins
primary_metrics.timing: paired per-case task_total_wall_ns; median and MAD; complete counterbalance cycles only

schedule_contract.counterbalance: balanced_orders: every arm in every position twice, one forward and one reverse cycle
schedule_contract.execution_stage: P9/W10 only after development analysis is frozen

selection_rule: one hash-ordered bounded primary output per cluster; semantic first occurrence; round-robin static group/support/node strata

use_boundary.first_permitted_comparative_execution: P9/W10 untouched confirmation after development analysis and candidate are frozen
